title: A unified convergence theory for adaptive first-order methods in the nonconvex case, including AdaNorm, full and diagonal AdaGrad and Muon
abstract: arXiv:2604.17423v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A unified framework for first-order optimization algorithms fornonconvex unconstrained optimization is proposed that uses adaptivelypreconditioned gradients and includes popular methods such as full anddiagonal AdaGrad, AdaNorm, as well as an adpative variant of Muon. This framework also allows combining heterogeneous geometries across different groups of variables while preserving a unified convergence analysis. A fully stochastic global rate-of-convergence analysis is conducted for all methods in the framework, with andwithout two types of momentum, using reasonable assumptions on the variance of the gradient oracle and without assuming bounded stochastic gradients or small enough stepsize.

translated_title: 自适应一阶方法在非凸情形下的统一收敛理论，涵盖AdaNorm、全量及对角AdaGrad与Muon
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.17423v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：本文提出一个用于非凸无约束优化的一阶优化算法的统一框架，该框架利用自适应预条件梯度，并包含全量及对角AdaGrad、AdaNorm等流行方法，以及Muon的自适应变体。该框架还允许在不同变量组之间结合异质几何结构，同时保持统一的收敛性分析。对所有框架内的方法，在有无两种动量类型的情况下，进行了完全随机的全局收敛速率分析，基于对梯度随机源方差的合理假设，且不假设有界随机梯度或足够小的步长。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，涵盖多种自适应一阶优化算法（如AdaGrad、AdaNorm和Muon的自适应变体），在非凸情况下提供了不依赖有界梯度假设的全局收敛速率分析，并支持异质几何结构的组合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework for adaptive first-order methods (including AdaGrad, AdaNorm, and an adaptive Muon variant), providing global convergence rates in nonconvex settings without bounded-gradient assumptions, while supporting heterogeneous geometries across variable groups.
